_comment: Dual-target manifest for the P1 control-plane gate. Covers the READ surface of the 25 operations amk-http mounts, plus the error-shape asymmetry. Ids are PLACEHOLDERS resolved per target at runtime (see `resolve`), because the reference account's pod is not our pod and `inbox_id` IS an email address — a hardcoded id can only ever exist on one side. Mutating requests are NOT here: every POST/PATCH/DELETE in this phase creates or destroys a real resource on the reference account, so they are exercised by the SDK smoke against the candidate and added here only against a throwaway scope.

expected_divergences.$.billing_plan_id: no billing surface (project non-negotiable) — nothing truthful to put here, and an invented value would be worse than omitting it. Pinned by a test in amk-types::pod.
expected_divergences.$.clerk_organization_id: AgentMail authenticates through Clerk; this deployment does not. Same reasoning as billing_plan_id.

requests._note: unauth -> BARE {message} 401, not the full envelope (A8 asymmetry, fixture 05)
well-formed id that does not exist -> not_found envelope
malformed id in a path segment -> whatever the reference does, we must match
unknown path -> full envelope, code not_found (never a 405, fixture 05)
wrong method on a real path -> the SAME 404 envelope, never 405
